title: inline-size - Sizing - Tailwind CSS
content_text:
SIZING inline-size Utilities for setting the inline size of an element. Class Styles inline- inline-size: calc(var(--spacing) * ); inline- inline-size: calc( * 100%); inline-3xs inline-size: var(--container-3xs); /* 16rem (256px) */ inline-2xs inline-size: var(--container-2xs); /* 18rem (288px) */ inline-xs inline-size: var(--container-xs); /* 20rem (320px) */ inline-sm inline-size: var(--container-sm); /* 24rem (384px) */ inline-md inline-size: var(--container-md); /* 28rem (448px) */ inline-lg inline-size: var(--container-lg); /* 32rem (512px) */ inline-xl inline-size: var(--container-xl); /* 36rem (576px) */ inline-2xl inline-size: var(--container-2xl); /* 42rem (672px) */ SHOW MORE EXAMPLES Basic example Use inline- utilities like inline-24 and inline-64 to set an element to a fixed inline size based on the spacing scale: inline-96 inline-80 inline-64 inline-48 inline-40 inline-32

Resetting the inline size Use the inline-auto utility to remove an element's assigned inline size under a specific condition, like at a particular breakpoint:
Using a custom value Use the inline-[] syntax to set the inline size based on a completely custom value:
For CSS variables, you can also use the inline-() syntax:
This is just a shorthand for inline-[var()] that adds the var() function for you automatically. Responsive design Prefix an inline-size utility with a breakpoint variant like md: to only apply the utility at medium screen sizes and above:
Learn more about using variants in the variants documentation. Customizing your theme The inline- utilities are driven by the --spacing theme variable, which can be customized in your own theme: @theme { --spacing: 1px; } Learn more about customizing the spacing scale in the theme variable documentation. max-height min-inline-size
